events.why: step 64: the lab gate asks for five registered species, 3/5 after the tutorial: two new ones here in Wild Zone 1 before leaving, Scatterbug (on the road at 100 from the objective marker) and Mareep (in the grass right of the road at 60), so the gate's scene finds 5/5 (user, 2026-11-13). Patrol 100, 60, 100, 60, ...: walking to 100 and back brings Pokemon back at 60; 10 visits, 10 minutes, 12 throws at most. The party bar's filled slots decide, read before the first stop and after each stop that threw: 5 means done, since the throws go only at targets whose plate shows no caught mark, and the "Registered!" banner is missed at times (console B 2026-11-14 19:36: Mareep in the party, no banner seen).
